maintenance_message: KeyflawX is currently under maintenance. Please try again later.
update_message: KeyflawX 1.6.0 is available now with Pre-Render improvements, Easy Ease for Show All Layers, Pre-Export audio, and performance optimizations.
changelog: Pre-Render improvements (instant replay, full duration support, and smooth In/Out loop)
Added Easy Ease support when selecting keyframes through Show All Layers
Pre-Export preview now plays project audio in sync
Fixed bounding box remaining visible when no layer is selected (1.6.0)
Performance optimizations for lighter and smoother editing
All Keyflow features unlocked for free (1.6.0)
Long-press Motion Blur to adjust settings per layer
Automatically cancels preview when moving or editing the workspace
Easier and smoother switching between layers
View exported video directly when no changes were made after export
Keep screen awake automatically while exporting
